notes.text: Exact Tannaitic narrative attests the lot and quarry. The retrieved Sifra gives איש הבתה.
The retrieved Tosefta gives איש חבתה, and preserves R. Ḥananya ben Gamliel’s alternative that he was plowing.
The name form differs in both direct Tannaitic witnesses, while Vayikra Rabbah names Pinḥas the stonecutter.
Heilprin’s reported Tosefta witness reads Ha-Birah. The current digital Tosefta and Sifra have different forms, and the printed source for Ha-Birah remains to be collated.
